title: Prepare the 0.5.0 release: set the package version to 0.5.0 and date the change log section for 0.5.0
description: Prepare the 0.5.0 release: set the package version to 0.5.0 and date the change log section for 0.5.0
no_spec_change_rationale: Release preparation only: package version, change log and a release check on them; no contract changes.
acceptance_criteria: Leif ('Prepare 0.5.0 now', relayed by orc 2026-11-06). The package version is 0.5.0 in Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock. The change log moves every Unreleased entry under '## [0.5.0] - 2026-11-06' and adds a [0.5.0] link to the v0.5.0 release. A new check in tests/changelog.rs fails first at 0.5.0 without that section, and passes once the dated section and the link are in place. cargo package --list --locked shows only the documented files, cargo publish --dry-run --locked succeeds, and fledge lanes run verify and fledge run linux-verify pass. No tag, publish or GitHub release is made here.

answers.constraints: docs/releasing.md steps 1 to 4 (version, dated section and link, package list, dry run, owner check); the release proposal's reasons for 0.5.0 (relayed_by history events are unreadable by 0.4.0; native Windows dropped); no tag, publish or GitHub release until Leif OKs the list; LIFE-16 placement tests unchanged; #116 as the 0.4.0 precedent.
